mergedParams.userDescription: Sequential element fade. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Sequential Fade Effects for Text, Video & Images

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'SequentialFadeReveal' that provides a staggered fade-in effect for multiple elements. The effect should accept parameters for fadeDelay (time between each element's fade start), fadeDuration (how long each fade takes), and easingType (the easing curve to use). Each target element should fade in sequentially, creating a cascading reveal effect. The effect should support any number of target elements passed via targetIds array, automatically calculating the stagger timing based on the element's index. Include an optional 'reverse' parameter to fade elements in reverse order, and an 'overlap' parameter to control how much the fades overlap (0 = no overlap, 1 = fully overlapped). The opacity should animate from 0 to 1 using AnimationRange keyframes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: opacity (0 to 1). AnimationRange structure: [{key: 'opacity', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'opacity', val: 1, prog: 1}]. Input params: fadeDelay (number, ms), fadeDuration (number, ms), easingType (string: 'linear' | 'ease-in' | 'ease-out' | 'ease-in-out'), reverse (boolean), overlap (number, 0-1). Effect mode: provider. Calculate start time for each targetId based on index * (fadeDelay * (1 - overlap)). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return format: {effects: targetIds.map((id, index) => ({type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [id], start: calculatedStart, duration: fadeDuration, easing: easingType, ranges: opacityRanges}))}.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset named 'WaveformTextPulse' that creates audio-reactive scaling on text elements synchronized to bass frequencies. The effect should make text elements pulse/scale based on the bass intensity in the audio track, perfect for music videos or dynamic typography. Accept parameters for baseScale (resting scale value), maxScale (maximum scale on beat), sensitivity (how reactive to audio, 0-1), and smoothing (how smooth the transitions are). The effect should use waveform data to create organic, music-driven text animations. Include a 'pulseMode' parameter to choose between 'uniform' (all text scales together) or 'word' (each word scales independently with slight delays). Add threshold control to only trigger scaling above certain bass levels.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (audio-reactive). Waveform props: {type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.7, threshold: 0.3, smoothing: 0.2}. Input params: baseScale (number, default 1), maxScale (number, default 1.2), sensitivity (number, 0-1), smoothing (number, 0-1), pulseMode ('uniform' | 'word'), threshold (number, 0-1). Effect mode: provider. For 'word' mode, split targetIds and apply slight phase offsets. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: {presets: []}}. Return format: {effects: targetIds.map(id => ({type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [id], start: 0, duration: 'inherit', props: waveformConfig}))}.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset 'SlideAndFade' that combines transform and opacity animations for smooth element entrances. Elements should slide in from a specified direction while fading in simultaneously. Accept parameters for slideDistance (how far elements slide in pixels), slideDirection ('left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom'), fadeDuration (total animation time), and staggerDelay (delay between each element). The effect should use GPU-accelerated transforms (translateX/Y) for performance. Include an 'elasticBounce' parameter that adds a subtle overshoot and bounce-back using spring easing. Support diagonal directions by combining X and Y translations. Add a 'fadeFirst' parameter to control whether fade starts before, with, or after the slide motion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (Combined AnimationRange[]). Properties: opacity, translateX, translateY. AnimationRange: For slide-left: [{key: 'translateX', val: -slideDistance, prog: 0}, {key: 'translateX', val: 0, prog: 1}] combined with [{key: 'opacity', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'opacity', val: 1, prog: fadeFirst ? 0.6 : 1}]. Input params: slideDistance (number, px), slideDirection (string), fadeDuration (number, ms), staggerDelay (number, ms), elasticBounce (boolean), fadeFirst (number, 0-1). Effect mode: provider. Easing: elasticBounce ? 'spring' : 'ease-out'. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return format: {effects: targetIds.map((id, i) => ({type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [id], start: i * staggerDelay, duration: fadeDuration, easing, ranges: [...translateRanges, ...opacityRanges]}))}.

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset 'ColorWaveTransition' that creates a color shift effect across multiple elements, simulating a wave of color change. The effect should animate both text color and background color properties, creating a gradient wave that passes through elements sequentially. Accept parameters for startColor and endColor (hex values), waveDuration (how long the wave takes to pass through all elements), waveDirection ('horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'radial'), and colorProperty ('color' | 'backgroundColor' | 'both'). Include a 'pulseMode' option that makes colors pulse between start and end values instead of transitioning once. Add support for RGB interpolation for smooth color transitions.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: color, backgroundColor. Color interpolation using RGB values. AnimationRange: [{key: 'color', val: startColor, prog: 0}, {key: 'color', val: endColor, prog: 0.5}, {key: 'color', val: startColor, prog: 1}] for pulse mode. Input params: startColor (string, hex), endColor (string, hex), waveDuration (number, ms), waveDirection (string), colorProperty (string), pulseMode (boolean). Effect mode: provider. Calculate wave delay based on element position/index and waveDirection. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return format: {effects: targetIds.map((id, i) => ({type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [id], start: calculateWaveDelay(i), duration: waveDuration / targetIds.length, easing: 'ease-in-out', ranges: colorRanges}))}.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'BlurFocusSequence' that uses blur filters to create a depth-of-field focus transition across elements. Elements start blurred and come into sharp focus sequentially, simulating a camera rack focus effect. Accept parameters for maxBlur (maximum blur radius in pixels), focusDuration (time for each element to come into focus), focusOrder ('sequential' | 'random' | 'center-out' | 'edges-in'), and holdFocus (whether elements stay in focus or blur back). Include a 'depthLayers' parameter to group elements into focus planes that transition together. Add subtle brightness adjustment during blur for more realistic depth-of-field simulation.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: blur, brightness. AnimationRange: [{key: 'blur', val: maxBlur, prog: 0}, {key: 'blur', val: 0, prog: 0.5}, {key: 'blur', val: holdFocus ? 0 : maxBlur, prog: 1}], [{key: 'brightness', val: 0.7, prog: 0}, {key: 'brightness', val: 1, prog: 0.5}, {key: 'brightness', val: holdFocus ? 1 : 0.7, prog: 1}]. Input params: maxBlur (number, px), focusDuration (number, ms), focusOrder (string), holdFocus (boolean), depthLayers (number). Effect mode: provider. Calculate order based on focusOrder strategy. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return format: {effects: targetIds.map((id, i) => ({type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [id], start: calculateFocusDelay(i, focusOrder), duration: focusDuration, easing: 'ease-in-out', ranges: [...blurRanges, ...brightnessRanges]}))}.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset 'TypewriterReveal' specifically for text elements that simulates a typewriter effect using opacity and transform animations on individual characters or words. The effect should make text appear character by character or word by word with optional cursor animation. Accept parameters for typeSpeed (ms per character/word), unit ('character' | 'word' | 'line'), cursorBlink (boolean for cursor effect), and soundSync (boolean to sync with typewriter sound). Include a 'glitchMode' parameter that adds random opacity flickers and slight position jitters for a retro computer terminal effect. Support variable speed typing with 'naturalVariation' parameter for more human-like typing rhythm.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: opacity, translateX (for cursor), translateY (for glitch). For each text unit: [{key: 'opacity', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'opacity', val: 1, prog: 0.1}] with hold. Glitch adds: [{key: 'translateY', val: random(-2, 2), prog: random()}]. Input params: typeSpeed (number, ms), unit (string), cursorBlink (boolean), soundSync (boolean), glitchMode (boolean), naturalVariation (number, 0-1). Effect mode: provider. Split text into units, create sequential reveals. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return format: {effects: textUnits.map((unit, i) => ({type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [unit.id], start: i * (typeSpeed * (1 + random() * naturalVariation)), duration: typeSpeed, easing: 'linear', ranges: [...opacityRanges, ...(glitchMode ? glitchRanges : [])]}))}.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset 'FrequencyGlow' that creates an audio-reactive glow effect on elements based on frequency analysis. Elements should emit a pulsing glow (using drop-shadow or box-shadow) that responds to specific frequency ranges in the audio. Accept parameters for glowColor (base glow color), glowIntensity (max shadow blur radius), frequencyBand ('bass' | 'mid' | 'treble' | 'full'), and glowMode ('pulse' | 'sustain' | 'flash'). Include multi-color support where different frequency bands trigger different colored glows. Add a 'spreadRadius' parameter to control how far the glow extends. Support layered shadows for more complex glow effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (audio-reactive). Waveform props: {type: 'custom', audioProperty: frequencyBand, sensitivity: 0.8, threshold: 0.2}. Custom effect applies to CSS filter or boxShadow. Input params: glowColor (string, hex/rgba), glowIntensity (number, px), frequencyBand (string), glowMode (string), spreadRadius (number, px). Effect mode: provider. Generate shadow string: `0 0 ${blur}px ${spread}px ${color}`. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return format: {effects: targetIds.map(id => ({type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [id], start: 0, duration: 'inherit', props: {type: 'filter', audioProperty: frequencyBand, customProperty: 'dropShadow', sensitivity, threshold}}))}.

prompts.prompt: Implement an internal effect preset 'ScaleRotateCascade' that combines scaling and rotation animations in a cascading sequence. Elements should scale up while rotating, creating a dynamic spiral-in effect. Accept parameters for scaleFrom (starting scale), scaleTo (ending scale), rotationDegrees (total rotation amount), cascadeDelay (delay between elements), and spiralDirection ('clockwise' | 'counter-clockwise'). Include an 'oscillate' mode where elements scale and rotate back and forth. Add 'transformOrigin' parameter to control the center point of rotation/scale. Support 3D rotation with rotateX/Y/Z for more complex effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: scale, rotate (or rotateX/Y/Z for 3D). AnimationRange: [{key: 'scale', val: scaleFrom, prog: 0}, {key: 'scale', val: scaleTo, prog: oscillate ? 0.5 : 1}, {key: 'scale', val: scaleFrom, prog: 1}] if oscillate. Rotation: [{key: 'rotate', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'rotate', val: rotationDegrees * (spiralDirection === 'clockwise' ? 1 : -1), prog: 1}]. Input params: scaleFrom (number), scaleTo (number), rotationDegrees (number), cascadeDelay (number, ms), spiralDirection (string), oscillate (boolean), transformOrigin (string). Effect mode: provider. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return format: {effects: targetIds.map((id, i) => ({type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [id], start: i * cascadeDelay, duration: 1000, easing: 'ease-in-out', transformOrigin, ranges: [...scaleRanges, ...rotateRanges]}))}.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'ResponsiveParallax' that simulates parallax scrolling effects for layered elements during video playback. Elements move at different speeds based on their assigned depth layer, creating a sense of 3D depth. Accept parameters for parallaxIntensity (overall movement strength), layerCount (number of depth layers), moveDirection ('horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'both'), and baseSpeed (baseline movement speed). Include 'autoLayer' mode that automatically assigns depths based on element size or z-index. Add 'perspectiveShift' option that also scales elements based on their depth. Support custom easing per layer for more natural motion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: translateX, translateY, scale (for perspective). Calculate layer depth: (index % layerCount) / layerCount. Movement per layer: baseMovement * (1 - depth * parallaxIntensity). AnimationRange: [{key: 'translateY', val: -movement, prog: 0}, {key: 'translateY', val: movement, prog: 1}]. Scale for perspective: [{key: 'scale', val: 1 - (depth * 0.2), prog: 0}, {key: 'scale', val: 1, prog: 0.5}, {key: 'scale', val: 1 + (depth * 0.1), prog: 1}]. Input params: parallaxIntensity (number, 0-1), layerCount (number), moveDirection (string), baseSpeed (number, px), autoLayer (boolean), perspectiveShift (boolean). Effect mode: provider. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return format: {effects: targetIds.map((id, i) => ({type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [id], start: 0, duration: 'inherit', easing: `cubic-bezier(${0.25 + depth * 0.1}, 0.1, 0.25, 1)`, ranges: [...translateRanges, ...(perspectiveShift ? scaleRanges : [])]}))}.

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset 'MatrixRainFade' that creates a Matrix-style digital rain effect for text elements, where characters fade in with a green glow trail. Elements should fade in from top to bottom with a trailing glow effect that dissipates. Accept parameters for rainSpeed (how fast the effect moves), glowColor (color of the trailing glow), characterDelay (delay between each character), and glowDecay (how quickly the glow fades). Include 'randomizeOrder' to make characters appear in random order instead of sequential. Add 'flickerMode' for random opacity fluctuations mimicking digital interference. Support custom fonts and character sets for authentic Matrix appearance.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (Combined AnimationRange[]). Properties: opacity, color, textShadow (for glow). Main fade: [{key: 'opacity', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'opacity', val: 1, prog: 0.2}, {key: 'opacity', val: 0.7, prog: 1}]. Glow: [{key: 'textShadow', val: `0 0 20px ${glowColor}`, prog: 0.1}, {key: 'textShadow', val: '0 0 0px transparent', prog: 1}]. Color shift: [{key: 'color', val: glowColor, prog: 0}, {key: 'color', val: 'inherit', prog: 0.5}]. Input params: rainSpeed (number, ms), glowColor (string), characterDelay (number, ms), glowDecay (number, 0-1), randomizeOrder (boolean), flickerMode (boolean). Effect mode: provider. Split into characters, apply sequential or random order. PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return format: {effects: characters.map((char, i) => ({type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [char.id], start: (randomizeOrder ? random() : i) * characterDelay, duration: rainSpeed, easing: 'linear', ranges: [...opacityRanges, ...glowRanges, ...colorRanges, ...(flickerMode ? flickerRanges : [])]}))}.
